title: Your Attention Span Is Being Trained Against You #Shorts
description:
The average person switches tasks every few seconds. That is not a flaw in you. It is a response to an environment built to interrupt.

Try twenty five minutes with the phone in another room. Not silent. Another room. Distance beats willpower every time.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: The average person switches tasks every few seconds, and that is not a flaw in you. It is a response to an environment built to interrupt.
The interruption itself is cheap. The recovery is not. Refocusing can take far longer than the distraction lasted.
Each switch also leaves residue from the previous task in working memory, so you arrive at the next one carrying it.
The people who focus best are not more disciplined. They removed the choice, so there is nothing to resist.
Try twenty five minutes with the phone in another room. Not silent. Another room. Distance beats willpower every time.
